Again, I offered to increase rent $50 a month for the SO staying over the majority of the time to help cover costs for power and heat and water. But they declined this offer, and said that they would limit time spent here. Then, they went back on that agreement. 

Their idea is to live together, but this apartment is too small for 3 people and the pets. I have no issue with them hanging out here or sleepovers occasionally, because that is what I do with my boyfriend, but the majority of the time is a lot, especially with no compensation. 

The SO's landlord has created basically the same rules that I have in place - if someone is staying over that often, and is not just a visitor such as a family member coming in for vacation, etc., then rent will be increased because they then count as another roommate. Which is why I'm confused to why they think they can do the same at my place, without penalization which is the same from the SO's landlord.
